raw_semantics_audit.xnas_execution_normalization: T -> F -> C sharing sequence and quantity

modify_decomposition.price_changed: withdraw old_size at old price; add new_size at new price

raw_semantics_audit.snapshot_flag: F_SNAPSHOT marks book state, not order events
raw_semantics_audit.determination: raw MBO supports direct IAG measurement; proceed

removed_from_v1.reason: belonged to the feature-cadence representation and caused the resolution mismatch

raw_quality_gates.G2_coverage: first ts_recv <= t0 and last ts_recv >= t_obs_end
raw_quality_gates.G3_timing: no F_BAD_TS_RECV and no F_MAYBE_BAD_BOOK in [t0, t_obs_end]
raw_quality_gates.G4_reconstruction: no fatal reconstruction defect for the session
raw_quality_gates.G5_two_sided_book: at the t0 anchor state and the t_obs_end state
raw_quality_gates.G6_coherent_state: at least one coherent F_LAST inside the window
raw_quality_gates.derived_structural_minimum: 3 signable trades, implied by the 3-of-4 persistence rule, not a separate gate

direction.signed_formula: +size if side==B, -size if side==A, 0 if side==N
direction.net_flow: sum of signed(r) over records with t0 <= ts_recv <= t_obs_end

persistence.boundaries: first three half-open, last closed on t_obs_end

state_selection_rule.S_of_t: state at the LATEST coherent F_LAST with ts_recv <= t
fail_closed_when: no coherent state at or before t
state_selection_rule.tile_endpoint: latest coherent F_LAST INSIDE the tile; tile dropped if none
state_selection_rule.tile_lambda_start: S(tile_start), may come from an earlier tile

impacted_liquidity.depth_definition: summed displayed size over first 10 price levels of the impacted side
impacted_liquidity.S_of_t: impacted depth_10 at last coherent F_LAST with ts_recv <= t
impacted_liquidity.D_min: min over coherent F_LAST with t0 <= ts_recv <= t_obs_end
impacted_liquidity.depletion_ratio: D_min / D_ref if D_ref > 0 else undefined
impacted_liquidity.recovery_ratio: (D_end - D_min) / (D_ref - D_min) if D_ref > D_min else 1.0
impacted_liquidity.M2: percentile(D_end, causal baseline of impacted-side end-of-tile depth) <= 25

cancellation_addition.exclude_execution_driven: native-event group containing any T or F
cancellation_addition.withdrawn: C size + M same-price size decrease + M price-change old_size
cancellation_addition.added: A size + M same-price size increase + M price-change new_size + M unknown-order new_size
cancellation_addition.withdrawal_pressure: withdrawn / (added + withdrawn) if denominator > 0 else undefined

replenishment.statistic: added on the impacted side at or after the F_LAST attaining D_min, within the window

local_lambda.mid_start: midpoint at last coherent F_LAST with ts_recv <= t0
local_lambda.mid_end: midpoint at last coherent F_LAST with ts_recv <= t_obs_end
local_lambda.on_undefined: S3 not satisfied; event not disqualified

qualification.rule: M1 and M2 and M3 and M4 and (S1+S2+S3+S4 >= 2)

baseline.construction: non-overlapping 120s tiles at absolute UTC multiples
baseline.causality: prior certified sessions plus current session strictly before t0
baseline.tile_dropped_when: no coherent F_LAST in the tile

specifications.ladder: PRIMARY counts -> if >=100 events and >=15 sessions select PRIMARY; else FALLBACK counts -> if >=100 and >=15 select FALLBACK; else insufficient_sample and no economic run

architecture.why: 60-minute quiet period vs 120-second window guarantees non-overlap
depth_computed_at: F_LAST states inside an open window
architecture.empirical_anchor: Stage 1 processed the same 562M records to emit 19.5M feature rows and completed; v2 does strictly less per record
architecture.calibration_required: timing probe on one symbol-day before the full pass
